say:2:1223208001:1.text: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!
say:2:1223208001:1.source_cn: 一万金币，一个子都不能少！
say:2:1223208001:1.male: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!
say:2:1223208001:1.female: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!

say:3:1223208002:1.text: Sir, we're willing to pay, but you should keep your demand reasonable.
say:3:1223208002:1.source_cn: 老板，我们愿意赔偿，但是您也不能狮子大开口，漫天要价呀。

say:4:1223208003:1.text: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!
say:4:1223208003:1.source_cn: 我那两箱不是本地水果，是外地商船运回来的，进货价就要贵一点！
say:4:1223208003:1.male: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!
say:4:1223208003:1.female: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!

say:5:1223208004:1.text: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
say:5:1223208004:1.source_cn: 而且我这批水果断货了，竞争对手就会把他的货临时涨价，我...
say:5:1223208004:1.male: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
say:5:1223208004:1.female: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.

choice_prompt:6:1223208004.text: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.source_cn: 而且我这批水果断货了，竞争对手就会把他的货临时涨价，我这损失可就大咯。
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.male: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.female: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.

say:7:1223208005:0.text: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.
say:7:1223208005:0.source_cn: 你平时是这样跟商人打交道的吗？呵、呵……那我只能说，我...
say:7:1223208005:0.male: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.
say:7:1223208005:0.female: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.

say:8:1223208021:0.text: Just settle the payment now, alright? I've already compromised a lot.
say:8:1223208021:0.source_cn: 行了，交钱吧，我已经让的够多了。

say:11:1223208022:1.text: Here's the money, buddy. I apologize on Cecil's behalf for losing your goods.
say:11:1223208022:1.source_cn: 哥们，这是赔偿金，实在对不住哈，这小子粗心大意弄丢了您的货。

say:12:1223208023:1.text: Don't "buddy" me. Save your pleasantries for others.
say:12:1223208023:1.source_cn: 谁是你哥们？客套话就免了。

say:13:1223208024:1.text: Well, we're practically friends now. Next time you need our services, we'll give you a discount.
say:13:1223208024:1.source_cn: 不打不相识，下次您找我们干活，给您友情价。

say:14:1223208025:1.text: Hmph... I guess you're the smart one of the group. We'll see.

say:19:1223208026:0.text: I'm surprised. You're pretty business savvy. You even promoted your business at the end.
say:19:1223208026:0.source_cn: 看不出来嘛，你还算细心，懂得为自己招揽生意。

say:20:1223208027:1.text: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.
say:20:1223208027:1.source_cn: 都是这段时间学会的，太感谢<style=stress>...
say:20:1223208027:1.male: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.
say:20:1223208027:1.female: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.

say:23:1223208028:0.text: Cecil, go and get Paz. It's time to head back to the camp.
say:23:1223208028:0.source_cn: 西索，去叫上帕斯，该回营地了。

say:24:1223208029:0.text: Paz isn't feeling well, and he's already gone back to the camp.
say:24:1223208029:0.source_cn: 帕斯他情况不太好，已经先回营地了。

say:26:1223208031:1.text: You'll find out when you see him.

say:28:1223208006:1.text: That's right. Every official merchant ship keeps proof of delivery, and we can use it to identify the missing fruit before compensating according to the market price.
say:28:1223208006:1.source_cn: 没错，每艘官方认可的商船都会有出货记录，我们要确定那是...

say:29:1223208007:1.text: If you can't provide evidence, it means your goods are smuggled... The Carmine Whispers won't go easy on you if they find out!
say:29:1223208007:1.source_cn: 如果你不能提供证据，就说明你这几箱水果是偷渡的……如果...

say:31:1223208009:1.text: We won't report you, but you have to accept our offer.
say:31:1223208009:1.source_cn: 如果没有进出货证明的话，我们可以不举报给血薇帮，但只能...

say:32:1223208010:1.text: Quite a bargain for you, huh?

say:33:1223208011:1.text: Hmph, since you mentioned the Carmine Whispers, I'll be the bigger man here and accept your offer.
say:33:1223208011:1.source_cn: 哼，都搬出血薇帮了，那就不和你们计较那么多了。

choice:6:1:2.text: Prove the price of the fruit.
choice:6:1:2.male: Prove the price of the fruit.
choice:6:1:2.female: Prove the price of the fruit.

say:34:1223208012:1.text: If you want to factor in your additional losses, we'll also need to account for our manpower costs to keep things fair.
say:34:1223208012:1.source_cn: 如果你要计较额外的损失，公平起见，我们这边也要计算损失...

say:37:1223208013:1.text: Right! You haven't paid me for my work yet!

say:38:1223208014:1.text: This makes no sense. Hmph... Are you suggesting that I have to compensate you instead?
say:38:1223208014:1.source_cn: 这叫什么道理？呵……难道我还要赔偿你们吗？

say:41:1223208015:1.text: Of course not. It's only fair for Cecil to compensate for the goods he lost.
say:41:1223208015:1.source_cn: 当然没有这意思，他弄丢了货物，赔偿是应该的。

say:42:1223208016:1.text: But he hasn't even been paid for his work. How is he supposed to come up with the money for you?
say:42:1223208016:1.source_cn: 但他连工钱都没拿到，怎么有钱赔你呢？

say:43:1223208017:1.text: You need to settle his wages first before he can pay.
say:43:1223208017:1.source_cn: 为了让他有钱赔你，你要先结清工钱。

say:45:1223208019:1.text: Wait, no! I'd end up getting paid less if that's the case! I nearly fell for your trick!
say:45:1223208019:1.source_cn: 不，不！这样我得到的赔偿就少了，好险，差点就被你们糊弄了。

say:46:1223208020:1.text: Fine, I'll give you all a discount. Today just isn't my day.
say:46:1223208020:1.source_cn: 这样吧，给你们少一点，算我倒霉。
